column5: Comparator: the retired brick-kiln coal screening
column10: COMPARATOR, not a configuration: the reference CONTAINS measured brick-kiln coal (2.78 Mt, HDIP coal-by-consumer FY2023-24) since the rc46 activation, so the FY2022-23-vintage screening (7.35 Mt) is superseded and adding it would double-count - the configuration brick_kiln_coal_in_scope is retired (rc47 Wave 0). The gap between the two is a vintage-and-method note, not an alternative: the measured reference year is a trough (1,129 kt) in a series the screening's FY2022-23 vintage (2,991 kt) does not describe. column5: Comparator: the retired captive-coal capacity bracket
column10: COMPARATOR, not a configuration: the industrial_solid_fuels_1a2 activation gate's own text records that captive coal sits INSIDE the brick residual column the reference now books (supply exhausts consumption, so a separate captive activation would double-count) - the configuration captive_coal_in_scope is retired (rc47 Wave 0) and the bracket (0.17-1.31 Mt) stands as the register-sized bound on the captive share OF the booked residual, not as mass to add. column5: Excluded: fertiliser gas, feed and process fuel (756 MMCFD)
column10: Deliberately absent, on the IPCC ammonia method: the TOTAL gas requirement of ammonia production - feedstock and process fuel together, 83.5/16.5 on NFDC's monthly plant annex for this fiscal year - belongs to 2B1, and only separately metered auxiliary combustion outside the process boundary would stay in 1A2. The feedstock carbon leaves as urea and is priced by the 2B1 ledger and at application in 3.H; booking the row here would inflate the category three and a half fold and double-count against the ammonia accounting.
